sampling: Same three Day 2 training subjects; all existing 42-day cases (three per person) plus earliest-ending existing 14-day case per person. Select using identity/history/end_date only; no replacement or label/value filtering.
knowledge: Eight fixed source-traceable pairs from complete Day 2 units. No new health facts, hard predicates or source thresholds. Candidate discriminability is a hypothesis, not certified by pair construction.

reference.view: Full 288 legal results for the case, independent of online arms; absolute dates/subject IDs/raw rows excluded
reference.blinding: Fresh stateless requests; no old labels, ranker/features/outputs, arm names, intended effect, acquisition choices or previous Silver summaries
reference.orientation: Every packet has a fresh mirrored candidate-order packet; no conversation/cache reuse between the two
reference.independence: Request-level isolation is testable. Same Qwen family, public data exposure and model prior dependence remain; mirrored review is not a second independent assessor or human Gold.
reference.primary: Use primary-view grades only when both views pass binding/semantic checks and their canonical preference agrees. Report exact grade disagreement separately. Unknown never zero.

online.B: Topic metric means at 7 and 14 days, plus rhr mean at 14 days; three given seed probes
online.C: B plus topic metric mean_difference at 14 days versus preceding 28 days
online.D: B plus topic metric mean_difference at 7 days versus preceding 28 days; matched active temporal control, NOT assumed irrelevant
online.D0: B plus rhr mean_difference at 14 days; unrelated structural control, NOT sufficient evidence of acquisition success

ranker.formula: For acquired topic mean_difference with matching observed mean of its horizon: z=delta/(abs(current)+abs(current-delta)), zero denominator=>0. Candidate score=direction_link*z+magnitude_link*abs(z), averaged across acquired compatible horizons. All coefficients fixed in pairs.py before new references.
ranker.coefficient_scope: Unitless research hypotheses, not thresholds/medical advice or source-asserted priority weights
ranker.unknown: No acquired valid comparison => tied scores plus explicit unresolved state; missing is not an adverse personal state
ranker.temporal_control: C and D use identical code/coefficient path, differing only legal horizon/result. D0 has no source-compatible metric; structural suppression reported, never counted as empirical specificity.
ranker.legacy: Day 2 ranker retained unmodified and replayed as historical diagnostic only; its rhr suppression is not an empirical negative-control success

signal_gate: At least one pair has source-audited, mirrored-consistent known reference relations that differ across real people/windows with the same exact Goal, and at least one changed-context judgment explicitly depends on COMPUTED compatible evidence. GOAL_ONLY variation, unknown-to-known coverage, source-invalid or position-inconsistent variation does not count.

evaluation.reference: One shared accepted full-record reference per case/pair, all arms identical qrel mask
evaluation.two_candidate_caveat: @3 and @5 are identical on a two-item slate; no catalog retrieval claim
evaluation.equal_reference_grades: NDCG and strict-pair metrics null; retain known tie as reference coverage

reliability.aggregation: Mean within each participant, then unweighted across people; windows/pairs not independent people
analyses: exclude all overlapping-source or unequal-granularity pairs
within-person chronological change and across-person same Goal
C-vs-D matched active control and D0 structural control separately
same cited evidence with opposite preferences
reliability.no_synthetic_research_cohort: Existing real cases cover observed variation; synthetic values used only in explicitly labeled software/unit mechanism tests, never source-derived qrels

decision.SIGNAL_SUPPORTED_EXPLORATORY: Pass source-audited evidence-dependent real reference gate; positive matched C-D participant macro utility with nonnegative leave-one-person-out direction and supported preference recovery beyond structural D0; mirror/granularity sensitivity direction retained. AI evidence remains exploratory and no automatic formal benchmark/baseline authorization.
decision.MEASUREMENT_OR_TASK_REDESIGN_REQUIRED: Adequate returned/reviewed real reference material but no defensible evidence-conditioned relation changes, or improvements explained by Goal/source/structural controls rather than evidence discrimination
decision.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Missing/failed/semantically rejected or position-inconsistent reference material prevents assessing the mechanism

minimum_reference_material_for_design_di: Returned and source-reviewed judgments for all eight pairs in at least two people; unknown is a reported outcome, not a fabricated grade
